about_the_game:
Faeborne is story-driven action-adventure game set in a cinematic fantasy world where emotions manifest into creatures of darkness. You play as a young Fae-Knight whose sister creates an army of stone golems born from her fear, anger, and hatred which begin attacking the citadel of Lamparis. Armed only with your blade and a lantern that holds fragments of lost childhood memories… how far will you go to bring her home?

Key Features

  • Action-Packed Combat
    Master fast, responsive swordplay with parries, dashes, time-slowing abilities, and magical strikes. Every encounter tests your skill while pushing the story forward.

  • Epic Boss Battles
    Confront creatures of darkness born from fear, anger, and hate. Each clash is both a test of strength and an emotional turning point that moves the story forward.

  • Precision Platforming

    Leap, climb, dash, and glide through intricate traversal challenges designed for speed and accuracy. The world of Lamparis demands timing, flow, and mastery of movement as much as combat.

  • Puzzle Solving & Secrets
    Use the lantern of memories to solve environmental puzzles, reveal hidden paths, and uncover fragments of lost childhood memories.

  • Explore a Cinematic Fantasy World
    Journey through enchanted forests, ancient elven ruins, and rebuild the citadel of Lamparis. The setting captures the scope of classic high fantasy sagas, told through an indie lens.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 (6GB) or AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 25 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Designed for mid-range PCs. Performance may vary depending on graphical settings.
